attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Horn Hazard

cards.label: ParasCard

attacks.name: Sludge

cards.flavor: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: KakunaLv20Card
cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavor: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokemon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

attacks.name: Poison Fluid
attacks.description: If Kakuna is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Kakuna is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokemon is now Poisoned. This power stops working while Kakuna is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.label: EkansLv15Card
cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavor: A carnivore that swallows its prey whole. Pidgeys and Spearows are its favorite food.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: ArbokLv30Card
cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavor: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Deadly Poison
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. If the Defending Pokemon was already Poisoned, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.label: DarkArbokCard
cards.name: Dark Arbok
cards.flavor: Freezes its prey with its stare. If you should encounter one, remember not to look into its eyes.

attacks.name: Stare
attacks.description: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.) If that Pokemon has a Pokemon Power, that power stops working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Vapor
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.label: NidoranFLv12Card
cards.name: Nidoran F
cards.flavor: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokemon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't attack Nidoran  F during your opponent's next turn. (Benching either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: NidorinaLv22Card
cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavor: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

attacks.name: Strength in Numbers
attacks.description: Does 10 more damage for each of your Benched Nidoran M, Nidoran F, Nidorino, Nidorina, Nidoking, and Nidoqueen.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.description: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.label: NidoranMLv22Card
cards.name: Nidoran M
cards.flavor: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.description: During your next turn, Nidoran M's Horn Rush attack's base damage is doubled.

attacks.name: Horn Rush
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.label: NidorinoLv23Card
cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavor: An aggressive Pokemon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

attacks.name: Swift Lunge
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing and this Pokemon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.label: ZubatLv9Card
cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavor: Lives in dark caves. Can occasionally be seen at night, when it flies in search of food.

cards.label: ZubatLv12Card
cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavor: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

attacks.name: Suspicious Soundwave
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.label: GolbatLv25Card
cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavor: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.description: Heal from this Pokemon the same amount of damage you did to the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Nosedive
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokemon does 40 damage to itself.

cards.label: DarkGolbatCard
cards.name: Dark Golbat
cards.flavor: Sneaks up silently on its prey and attacks it from behind, sometimes killing it with one bite.

attacks.name: Sneak Attack
attacks.description: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokemon from your hand, you may do 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Flitter
attacks.description: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.label: OddishLv21Card
cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavor: It wanders around at night sowing its seeds to create more Oddishes.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: DarkGloomCard
cards.name: Dark Gloom
cards.flavor: Its pollen has such a strong smell that it even confuses itself at times.

attacks.name: Pollen Stench
attacks.description: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused; if tails, your Active Pokemon is now Confused. This power can't be used if Dark Gloom is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: DarkVileplumeCard
cards.name: Dark Vileplume
cards.flavor: Perhaps because of their strong-smelling pollen, other Pokemon do not approach areas where Vileplumes live.

attacks.name: Hay Fever
attacks.description: No Trainer cards can be played. This power stops working while Dark Vileplume is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Petal Whirlwind
attacks.description: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, Dark Vileplume is now Confused (after doing damage).

cards.label: ParasLv15Card
cards.name: Paras
cards.flavor: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

attacks.name: Scatter Spores
attacks.description: Search your deck for a Basic Pokemon named Paras and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

cards.label: ParasectLv29Card
cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavor: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

attacks.name: Toxic Spore
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.description: Heal from this Pokemon the same amount of damage you did to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.label: VenonatLv15Card
cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavor: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

attacks.name: Disable
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokemon's attacks. That Pokemon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.label: VenomothLv22Card
cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavor: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

attacks.name: Stir Up Twister
attacks.description: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokemon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokemon. Then, switch your Active Pokemon with 1 of your Benched Pokemon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Rainbow Powder
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: BellsproutLv10Card
cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavor: A carnivorous Pokemon that traps and eats bugs. It appears to use its root feet to replenish moisture.

attacks.name: Sway
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokemon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: WeepinbellLv23Card
cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavor: It spits out PoisonPowder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

attacks.name: Regeneration
attacks.description: Remove all damage counters from this Pokemon. Discard all Evolution cards and Energy cards attached to this Pokemon.

attacks.name: Dissolve
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.label: GrimerLv10Card
cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavor: It has recently been found that Grimers are formed in waste-processing plants, and can move into towns via the sewers.

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Sticky Hands
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.label: DarkMukCard
cards.name: Dark Muk
cards.flavor: Muks appear suddenly, spreading sludge everywhere. Whenever one appears in a city, panic ensues.

attacks.name: Sticky Goo
attacks.description: As long as Dark Muk is your Active Pokemon, your opponent pays more to retreat his or her Active Pokemon. This power stops working while Dark Muk is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Sludge Punch
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: KoffingLv12Card
cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavor: First discovered in a weapons factory, this Pokemon can now be found almost anywhere.

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: KoffingLv14Card
cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavor: In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Confusion Gas
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.label: WeezingLv26Card
cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavor: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two Koffings can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

attacks.name: Poison Mist
attacks.description: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, until the end of your next turn, all Poisoned Pokemon take 20 damage instead of 10 damage from Poison after each player's turn. This power can't be used and stops working while this Pokemon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Gas Explosion
attacks.description: This Pokemon does 30 damage to itself. If this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokemon and your opponent chooses a new Active Pokemon, your opponent's new Active Pokemon becomes Poisoned.

cards.label: DarkWeezingCard
cards.name: Dark Weezing
cards.flavor: Researchers have observed these Pokemon reproducing in industrial waste sites.

attacks.name: Mass Explosion
attacks.description: Does 20 damage times the total number of Koffings, Weezings, and Dark Weezings in play (Apply Weakness and Resistance.). Then, this attack does 20 damage to each Koffing, Weezing, and Dark Weezing (even your own). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Stun Gas
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned; if tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: ScytherLv23Card
cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavor: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.description: Scyther can't use this attack during your next turn. (Benching or evolving Scyther ends this effect.)

cards.label: PinsirLv15Card
cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavor: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

attacks.name: Slicing Throw
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.label: CharmanderLv9Card
cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavor: Many people find it cute and try to hold it, only to be burned by its tail.

attacks.name: Gather Fire
attacks.description: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Fire Energy card attached to 1 of your other Pokemon and attach it to Charmander. This power can't be used if Charmander is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.label: CharmanderLv12Card
cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavor: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.description: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokemon is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.label: DarkCharmeleonCard
cards.name: Dark Charmeleon
cards.flavor: Its tail is incredibly strong, able to lift up to 5 adult men.

attacks.name: Fireball
attacks.description: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Charmeleon. Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.label: DarkCharizardCard
cards.name: Dark Charizard
cards.flavor: Seemingly possessed, it spews fire like a volcano, trying to burn all it sees.

attacks.name: Continuous Fireball
attacks.description: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Charizard. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. Discard a number of Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Charizard equal to the number of heads.

cards.label: VulpixLv13Card
cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavor: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

attacks.name: Foxfire
attacks.description: Before doing damage, you may switch the Defending Pokemon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon.

cards.label: DarkNinetalesCard
cards.name: Dark Ninetales
cards.flavor: Occasionally bewitches trainers with its mysterious alluring powers.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.description: Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, your opponent doesn't draw a card at the beginning of his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Nine Tails
attacks.description: Flip 9 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.label: GrowlitheLv12Card
cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavor: A Pokemon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.description: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Growlithe or this attack does nothing.

cards.label: GrowlitheLv16Card
cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavor: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

attacks.name: Errand-Running
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.description: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to this Pokemon in order to use this attack.

cards.label: ArcanineLv35Card
cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavor: A legendary Pokemon in China. Many people are charmed by its grace and beauty while running.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.description: Arcanine does 20 damage to itself.

cards.label: PonytaLv8Card
cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavor: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, discard 1 Energy card attached to this Pokemon.

cards.label: PonytaLv15Card
cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavor: A gentle grass-eater, it will allow riders on its back. However, anyone attempting to do so must be careful to not get burned.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.description: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Ponyta in order to use this attack.

cards.label: RapidashLv30Card
cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavor: Very competitive, this Pokemon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

attacks.name: Flame Inferno
attacks.description: You may discard up to 2 Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokemon. If you do, this attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded.

attacks.name: Kick Away
attacks.description: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokemon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokemon.

cards.label: DarkRapidashCard
cards.name: Dark Rapidash
cards.flavor: A wild, uncontrollable Pokemon. When running, it looks like a comet streaking through the sky.

attacks.name: Flame Pillar
attacks.description: You may discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Dark Rapidash when you use this attack. If you do and if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.label: MagmarLv18Card
cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavor: Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.

attacks.name: Smog
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.label: MagmarLv27Card
cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavor: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

attacks.name: Burning Fire
attacks.description: When you use this attack, you may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to your Pokemon in play. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.label: DarkFlareonCard
cards.name: Dark Flareon
cards.flavor: A Pokemon with a hot temper that can't be controlled once it's angered. Capable of breathing flames hotter than 3000.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.description: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Dark Flareon.

attacks.name: Playing with Fire
attacks.description: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Flareon. Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.label: MoltresLv37Card
cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavor: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a giant dazzle of flashing flames.

attacks.name: Dry Up
attacks.description: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon and flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard 1 Water Energy card attached to that Pokemon, if any.

cards.label: MoltresLv40Card
cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavor: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a giant dazzle of flashing flames.

attacks.name: Firegiver
attacks.description: When you put Moltres into play during your turn (not during set-up), put from 1 to 4 (chosen at random) Fire Energy cards from your deck into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Dive Bomb
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.label: SquirtleLv14Card
cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavor: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.

cards.label: SquirtleLv15Card
cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavor: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

attacks.name: Water Power
attacks.description: During your next turn, this Pokemon's Pound attack's base damage is tripled.

cards.label: SquirtleLv16Card
cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavor: Cute Pokemon that charms people with its innocent eyes. Loves swimming all day long.

cards.label: WartortleLv24Card
cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavor: When tapped, this Pokemon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: DarkWartortleCard
cards.name: Dark Wartortle
cards.flavor: A Pokemon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood - which is often.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.description: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Mirror Shell
attacks.description: If an attack does damage to Dark Wartortle during your opponent's next turn (even if Dark Wartortle is Knocked Out), Dark Wartortle attacks the Defending Pokemon for an equal amount of damage.

cards.label: DarkBlastoiseCard
cards.name: Dark Blastoise
cards.flavor: An aggressive Pokemon that tackles anything it sees.

attacks.name: Hydrocannon
attacks.description: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Dark Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Rocket Tackle
attacks.description: Dark Blastoise does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Dark Blastoise during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.label: PsyduckLv16Card
cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavor: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

attacks.name: Dizziness
attacks.description: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.description: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Psyduck but not used to pay for this attack. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.label: GolduckLv28Card
cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavor: Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.description: Does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.label: DarkGolduckCard
cards.name: Dark Golduck
cards.flavor: When Psyducks evolve, their headaches disappear and they find themselves in possession of formidable mental powers.

attacks.name: Third Eye
attacks.description: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Dark Golduck in order to draw up to 3 cards.

cards.label: PoliwagLv15Card
cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavor: Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: PoliwhirlLv30Card
cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavor: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

attacks.name: Twiddle
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused. If tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: PoliwrathLv40Card
cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavor: A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.description: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokemon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.label: SeelLv10Card
cards.name: Seel
cards.flavor: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.description: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokemon by attacks from the Defending Pokemon is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: DewgongLv24Card
cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavor: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.description: Remove all damage counters from this Pokemon. This Pokemon is no longer Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. This Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Aurora Wave
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.label: ShellderLv16Card
cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavor: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

attacks.name: Water Spout
attacks.description: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokemon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.label: KrabbyLv17Card
cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavor: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: KinglerLv33Card
cards.name: Kingler
cards.flavor: The large pincer has 10,000-horsepower crushing force. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

attacks.name: Salt Water
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 Water Energy cards and attach them to this Pokemon.

attacks.name: Double-Edged Pincers
attacks.description: During your opponent's next turn, all damage done to this Pokemon is doubled.

cards.label: HorseaLv20Card
cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavor: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokemon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.description: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokemon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.label: SeadraLv26Card
cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavor: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

attacks.name: Water Bomb
attacks.description: Does 10 damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokemon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost to your opponent's Benched Pokemon in any way you like. You can't do more than 20 damage in this way. (Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.label: StaryuLv17Card
cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavor: An enigmatic Pokemon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

attacks.name: Strange Beam
attacks.description: During your opponent's next turn, your Water Pokemon that have damage counters on them have no Weakness.

cards.label: DarkStarmieCard
cards.name: Dark Starmie
cards.flavor: This Pokemon has not yet taken hold in the ecosystem. This is because its birth and transformation take place through a mysterious power.

attacks.name: Rebirth
attacks.description: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may use this Power. If you don't have any Staryu in your deck, this Power does nothing. Discard Dark Starmie and all cards attached to it. Then 1 random Staryu in your deck is chosen and put onto the same place. Shuffle your deck afterward. This Power can't be used if Dark Starmie is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Spinning Shower
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, a number (1 or 2) of your opponent's Pokemon is chosen randomly, this attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) 1 random Energy card attached to each of them is discarded.

cards.label: MagikarpLv6Card
cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavor: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in this species of Pokemon.

attacks.name: Rapid Evolution
attacks.description: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Magikarp and put it on this Pokemon. (This counts as evolving this Pokemon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.label: MagikarpLv10Card
cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavor: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in Magikarp's body.

attacks.name: Trickle
attacks.description: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Dragon Rage
attacks.description: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Psycho Blast
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.label: GRsMewtwoCard
cards.name: Team GR's Mewtwo
cards.flavor: It's said to possess the power to control Dark Pokemon. Consequently, its body is never seen.

attacks.name: Dark Wave
attacks.description: Whenever 1 of your Pokemon with Dark in its name does damage to any Pokemon with an attack, flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, that attack does 20 more damage. If the second coin is tails, that attack does 10 more damage. If you have more than 1 Team GR's Mewtwo in play, use only 1 Dark Wave for an attack. This power stops working while Team GR's Mewtwo is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Dark Amplification
attacks.description: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Pokemon with Dark in their names on your Bench. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.label: PidgeyLv10Card

cards.label: PidgeottoLv38Card

cards.flavor: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokemon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokemon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.label: RattataLv12Card
cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavor: Loves to eat walnuts and acorns and nuts, processed goods, cheese, and milk.

attacks.name: Quick Attack

attacks.name: Tail Whip

cards.flavor: It suddenly appears from the clouds with a swooping attack that is difficult to dodge.

attacks.name: Fly High
attacks.description: During your next turn, Dark Fearow's Drill Dive attack's base damage is doubled.

attacks.name: Drill Dive
attacks.description: During your next turn, Dark Fearow can't attack or retreat.

cards.label: ClefairyLv15Card
cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavor: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

attacks.name: Shining Fingers
attacks.description: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.label: DarkClefableCard
cards.name: Dark Clefable
cards.flavor: If it senses anyone nearby, it will protect its friends with a mysterious power that only fairies possess.

attacks.name: Darkness Veil
attacks.description: If your Dark Pokemon is the Active Pokemon, all damage from attacks done to it during your opponent's turn is reduced by a random number (0, 10, 20). This Power stops working if Dark Clefable is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Dark Song
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep, and this attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon that isn't Dark Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.label: WigglytuffLv40Card
cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavor: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

attacks.name: Helping Hand
attacks.description: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokemon is on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove 1 Special Condition from your Active Pokemon.

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.description: All damage done to this Pokemon by attacks during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance.)

cards.label: MeowthLv10Card
cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavor: A popular Pokemon that earns money for its owner with its "Pay Day" ability.

attacks.name: Coin Hurl
attacks.description: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon and flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

cards.label: MeowthLv13Card
cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavor: Adores circular objects. Wanders the street on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

attacks.name: Cat Punch
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage. If tails and if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.label: MeowthLv17Card
cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavor: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop from picking them up.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes

cards.label: TaurosLv35Card
cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavor: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

attacks.name: Kicking and Stamping
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage. If tails, your opponent switches the Defending Pokemon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokemon.

cards.label: EeveeLv5Card
cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavor: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.label: EeveeLv9Card
cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavor: A rare and unique Pokemon about which little is known, as few have been captured.

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.description: If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.label: PorygonLv18Card
cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavor: A Pokemon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

attacks.name: 3-D Attack
attacks.description: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Conversion 2
attacks.description: Change this Pokemon's Resistance to a type of your choice other than Colorless.

cards.label: PorygonLv20Card
cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavor: More and more people play the slots every day, trying to win a Porygon.

attacks.name: Conversion 1
attacks.description: If the Defending Pokemon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless. (Benching either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.label: CoolPorygonCard
cards.name: Cool Porygon
cards.flavor: Its body is made of program. It has the ability to move at will through electronic space.

attacks.name: Texture Magic
attacks.description: You may change Cool Porygon's Resistance to a type of your choice other than Colorless. If the Defending Pokemon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless. (Benching either Pokemon ends the effect on that Pokemon.)

attacks.name: 3-D Attack
attacks.description: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.label: SnorlaxLv35Card
cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavor: Loves to doze, it will often fall asleep in the middle of roads.

attacks.name: Guard
attacks.description: As long as Snorlax is your Active Pokemon, the Defending Pokemon can't Retreat. This power stops working when Snorlax is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Roll Over
attacks.description: Snorlax is now Asleep. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.label: HungrySnorlaxCard
cards.name: Hungry Snorlax
cards.flavor: A lazy Pokemon that gets continually fatter by sticking to a cycle of sleeping and eating. Awake only when it eats.

attacks.name: Eat
attacks.description: Put 1 Food counter on Hungry Snorlax. You can't use this attack if Hungry Snorlax already has 2 Food counters on it.

attacks.name: Rollout
attacks.description: You may remove any number of Food counters from Hungry Snorlax. If you do, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 damage for each Food counter you removed. If you don't, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.label: DratiniLv12Card

attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.label: DarkDragonairCard
cards.name: Dark Dragonair
cards.flavor: As is fitting for a legendary Pokemon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

attacks.name: Evolutionary Light
attacks.description: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for an Evolution card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Dark Dragonair is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tail Strike
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.label: DragoniteLv43Card
cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavor: This Pokemon can fly in spite of its large bulk. It is said to be able to circumnavigate the earth in just 16 hours.

attacks.name: Special Delivery
attacks.description: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. If you do, choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. This power can't be used if Dragonite is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Supersonic Flight
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.label: DarkDragoniteCard
cards.name: Dark Dragonite
cards.flavor: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

attacks.name: Summon Minions
attacks.description: When you play Dark Dragonite from your hand, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokemon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Giant Tail
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.label: TogepiCard
cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavor: Still only a hatchling, it uses poison to chase off its enemies when threatened.

attacks.name: Snivel
attacks.description: If the Defending Pokemon attacks Togepi during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Togepi is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Mini-Metronome
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokemon's attacks. Mini-Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) (No matter what type the Defending Pokemon is, Togepi's type is still Colorless.) Togepi performs that attack.

cards.label: LugiaCard
cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavor: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

attacks.name: Aeroblast
attacks.description: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.label: ImakuniCardCard
cards.name: Imakuni?
cards.description: Your Active Pokemon is now Confused. This card cannot be put down on the field as a Pokemon.

cards.label: FossilExcavationCard
cards.name: Fossil Excavation
cards.description: You may search your deck for a Mysterious Fossil or choose 1 Mysterious Fossil in your discard pile. Show that card to your opponent and put it into your hand. Either way, shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.label: MaxReviveCard
cards.name: Max Revive
cards.description: Discard 2 Energy cards from your hand in order to put 1 Basic Pokemon from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't play Max Revive if your Bench is full.)

cards.label: SuperScoopUpCard
cards.name: Super Scoop Up
cards.description: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokemon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.label: ChallengeCard
cards.name: Challenge!
cards.description: Ask your opponent if he or she accepts your challenge. If your opponent declines (or if both Benches are full), draw 2 cards. If your opponent accepts, each of you searches your decks for any number of Basic Pokemon cards and puts them face down onto your Benches. (A player can't do this if his or her Bench is full.) When you both have finished, shuffle your decks and turn those cards face up.

cards.label: MoonStoneCard
cards.name: Moon Stone
cards.description: You may search your deck for a Colorless Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.label: ImposterOaksRevengeCard
cards.name: Imposter Oak's Revenge
cards.description: Discard a card from your hand in order to play this card. Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 4 cards.

cards.label: SleepCard
cards.name: Sleep!
cards.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.label: ComputerErrorCard
cards.name: Computer Error
cards.description: You may draw up to 5 cards, then your opponent may draw up to 5 cards. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

cards.label: DiggerCard
cards.name: Digger
cards.description: Flip a coin. If tails, do 10 damage to your Active Pokemon. If heads, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, your opponent does 10 damage to his or her Active Pokemon. If heads, you flip a coin. Keep doing this until a player gets tails.

cards.label: PokemonRecallCard
cards.name: Pokemon Retransfer
cards.description: Put an Evolution card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.label: TheBosssWayCard
cards.name: The Boss's Way
cards.description: Search your deck for an Evolution card with Dark Pokemon. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.label: GoopGasAttackCard
cards.name: Goop Gas Attack
cards.description: All Pokemon Powers stop working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.label: BillsTeleporterCard
cards.name: Bill's Teleporter
cards.description: Flip a coin. If heads, draw 4 cards.

cards.label: BillsComputerCard
cards.name: Bill's PC
cards.description: This card is needed to exchange either an Omanyte, Haunter, Machoke, Graveler, or Kadabra for its corresponding Evolution card.

cards.label: MasterBallCard
cards.name: Master Ball
cards.description: Look at 7 cards from the top of your deck. You may choose a Basic Pokemon or Evolution card from those cards, show it your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

cards.label: PokeballCard
cards.name: Poke Ball
cards.description: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for any Basic Pokemon or Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.label: NightlyGarbageRunCard
cards.name: Nightly Garbage Run
cards.description: Choose up to 3 Basic Pokemon cards, Evolution cards, and/or basic Energy cards from your discard pile. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

cards.label: RocketsSneakAttackCard
cards.name: Rocket's Sneak Attack
cards.description: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

cards.label: HereComesTeamRocketCard
cards.name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
cards.description: Each player plays with his or her Prize cards face up for the rest of the game.

cards.label: TheRocketsTrapCard
cards.name: The Rocket's Trap
cards.description: Flip a coin. If heads, choose up to 3 cards at random from your opponent's hand (don't look at them). Your opponent shuffles those cards into his or her deck.
